style: dark navy premium tech brand sting for a vehicle-damage inspection app; confident settle-in, sky-blue glow bloom (not warm/cream), clean uppercase wordmark, calm authoritative pacing suited to Reels/Stories

customize.note: logo-outro's stock piece-by-piece Figma-mark assembly does not fit a single monolithic brand SVG, so only its structural idioms are reused: radial glow bloom behind the logo, staggered fade/scale text reveal beneath the mark, absolute-canvas layout swapped to a flex hero-frame, and portrait 1080x1920 instead of the block's 1920x1080. Piece-assembly script is not reused.
customize.logo_entrance: single scale(0.72->1)+fade+slight y-offset settle, ease power3.out, ~0.7s
customize.glow: radial-gradient bloom in #1FB6FF at ~18% opacity, blooms in behind logo as it settles, holds soft
customize.text_sequence: product name fades/slides up beneath logo after logo settles; tagline fades in last, smaller + muted color
customize.hold: final resolved lockup (logo + name + tagline) holds static for the last ~1s

content.logo: inline SVG (supplied verbatim in brief, viewBox 0 0 156 156, gradient-fill vehicle-damage icon mark)
